  # CloudHealth SaaS platform AWS account ID (US region)
  cloudhealth_account_id = "750594782713"

resource "aws_iam_policy" "cloudhealth" {
  name        = local.policy_name
  description = "Customer-managed read-only policy for CloudHealth cost and usage analysis"

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Sid    = "CloudHealthReadOnlyAccess"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = [
          "account:GetAccountInformation",
          "account:GetAlternateContact",
          "account:GetContactInformation",
          "account:GetRegionOptStatus",
          "account:ListRegions",
          "autoscaling:Describe*",
          "budgets:Describe*",
          "budgets:List*",
          "ce:Describe*",
          "ce:Get*",
          "ce:List*",
          "cloudformation:Describe*",
          "cloudformation:Get*",
          "cloudformation:List*",
          "cloudtrail:Describe*",
          "cloudtrail:Get*",
          "cloudtrail:List*",
          "cloudtrail:LookupEvents",
          "cloudwatch:Describe*",
          "cloudwatch:Get*",
          "cloudwatch:List*",
          "config:Describe*",
          "config:Get*",
          "config:List*",
          "cost-optimization-hub:List*",
          "cost-optimization-hub:Get*",
          "directconnect:Describe*",

          "ec2:Get*",
          "ec2:List*",

          "ecr:Get*",
          "ecr:List*",

          "ecs:List*",

          "eks:List*",
          "elasticache:Describe*",
          "elasticache:List*",

          "elasticfilesystem:List*",

          "elasticmapreduce:List*",
          "es:Describe*",
          "es:List*",
          "firehose:Describe*",
          "firehose:List*",
          "glue:Get*",
          "glue:List*",
          "inspector:Describe*",
          "inspector:List*",
          "kinesis:Describe*",
          "kinesis:List*",
          "kms:Describe*",
          "kms:Get*",
          "kms:List*",
          "lambda:Get*",
          "lambda:List*",
          "logs:Describe*",
          "logs:Get*",
          "logs:List*",
          "organizations:Describe*",
          "organizations:List*",
          "rds:Describe*",
          "rds:List*",
          "redshift:Describe*",
          "redshift:List*",
          "route53:Get*",
          "route53:List*",
          "s3:Describe*",
          "s3:Get*",
          "s3:List*",
          "savingsplans:Describe*",
          "savingsplans:List*",
          "sns:Get*",
          "sns:List*",
          "sqs:Get*",
          "sqs:List*",
          "storagegateway:Describe*",
          "storagegateway:List*",
          "sts:GetAccessKeyInfo",
          "support:Describe*",
          "support:Get*",
          "tag:Get*",
          "tag:List*",
          "trustedadvisor:Describe*",
          "trustedadvisor:Get*",
          "trustedadvisor:List*",
          "waf:Get*",
          "waf:List*",
          "workspaces:Describe*",
          "workspaces:List*"
        ]
        Resource = "*"
      },
      {
        Sid    = "CloudHealthCostUsageAccess"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = [
          "pricing:Describe*",
          "pricing:Get*",
          "pricing:List*"
        ]
        Resource = "*"
      }
    ]
  })

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

# Cross-account IAM role for CloudHealth SaaS platform
resource "aws_iam_role" "cloudhealth" {
  name = local.role_name
  description = "Cross-account IAM role for CloudHealth SaaS platform cost and usage analysis"

  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Sid    = "CloudHealthAssumeRole"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Principal = {
          AWS = "arn:aws:iam::${local.cloudhealth_account_id}:root"
        }
        Action = "sts:AssumeRole"
        Condition = {
          StringEquals = {
            "sts:ExternalId" = var.cloudhealth_external_id
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  })

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}

# Attach the customer-managed policy to the role
resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "cloudhealth" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.cloudhealth.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.cloudhealth.arn
}

# External ID variable - provided by CloudHealth and unique per customer
variable "cloudhealth_external_id" {
  description = "The external ID provided by CloudHealth for secure cross-account role assumption"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  default     = "placeholder-external-id-replace-with-actual-cloudhealth-external-id"
}
